scripts.build:foundation: npm run build -w @mobiflow/contracts && npm run build -w @mobiflow/config
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:foundation && npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck -w @mobiflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @mobiflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build:foundation && npm run prisma:generate && npm run test -w @mobiflow/config && npm run test -w @mobiflow/api && npm run test -w @mobiflow/web
scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && npm run build -w @mobiflow/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:foundation && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/verification/m2-runtime.mjs && node --env-file=.env scripts/verification/m2-integration.mjs
scripts.demo:seed: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/dev/seed.mjs
scripts.eval:ai:m4: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/evaluation/m4-evaluate.mjs
scripts.verify:embedding:m5: npm run build:foundation && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/verification/m5-embedding.mjs
scripts.test:integration:m6: npm run build:foundation && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/verification/m2-integration.mjs --m6-only
scripts.test:integration:m7: npm run build:foundation && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @mobiflow/api && node --env-file=.env scripts/verification/m2-integration.mjs --m6-only --pattern "M7 manager"
